description: AUTHORITATIVE for South Korean official statistical time series — PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "Korea population by year from KOSIS", "Korean CPI series", "employment by region in Korea". Pulls the observations of one KOSIS (Statistics Korea) table: pass the producing organisation id and table id from kosis_stat_list or kosis_search, and get back period, classification, item, value and unit for the most recent N periods. Requires an API key (free at https://kosis.kr/openapi/).

_apiKey.description: Your KOSIS OpenAPI key. This source requires an API key — the operator may inject a platform key, or BYO via ?_apiKey=<key>. Free registration at https://kosis.kr/openapi/.

endPrdDe.description: Optional explicit period end, same format as startPrdDe.

itmId.description: Item id(s) to return, "+"-separated, or "ALL". Defaults to "ALL".

newEstPrdCnt.description: How many of the most recent periods to return. Default 5.

objL1.description: First classification axis value(s), "+"-separated, or "ALL" (default) for every category on that axis.

objL2.description: Optional second classification axis, same form as objL1. Only some tables have one.

orgId.description: Producing organisation id, e.g. "101" (Statistics Korea). From kosis_stat_list / kosis_search.

prdSe.description: Period type: "Y" yearly (default), "H" half-yearly, "Q" quarterly, "M" monthly, "D" daily. Must match what the table publishes.

startPrdDe.description: Optional explicit period start, e.g. "2015" for yearly or "202401" for monthly. Pass with endPrdDe INSTEAD of newEstPrdCnt for a fixed window.

tblId.description: KOSIS table id, e.g. "DT_1B040A3". From kosis_stat_list / kosis_search.

name: kosis_stat_data
title: Kosis Stat Data
